# Purpose

These answers are representative. Award credit for a correct lever free-body diagram, moment equilibrium about E, rigid-body displacement compatibility, an elastic trial solution, an explicit yield check, and a consistent elastic-perfectly plastic correction.

# Scope of the Base Problem

The base model treats the lever as rigid and the wires as identical elastic-perfectly plastic axial members. Lever bending, pivot and anchor strength, wire termination details, fatigue, fracture, slack, strain hardening, large rotation, and cyclic plasticity require additional models and data.

# Supplemental Assessment Structure

Suggested weighting:

- context interpretation and idealization: 20%;
- moment equilibrium and compatibility: 25%;
- elastic trial and yield check: 25%;
- corrected forces and elongations: 20%;
- engineering recommendation and limitations: 10%.
